# events
---

<!-- Generated by docs/5-reference/generate.py from the doc comments: do not edit. -->

Package events is the fairs and markets the artist sells at: the stock taken from the catalogue to the stand, the sales made there, what attending cost, and the profit left. Closing a fair brings what was not sold back to the catalogue.

| Name | What it is |
|---|---|
| `func DaysUntil(event Event, today calendar.Date) int` | DaysUntil is how many days are left until the fair starts. |
| `func RefusalWords(refusal Refusal) string` | RefusalWords is what the artist reads when an action on a fair is turned down. |
| `func WhenWords(event Event, today calendar.Date) string` | WhenWords is the fair's timing in a few words: "En curso", "Mañana", "Dentro de 50 días", or its dates when it is past. |
| `type Code string` | Code is a stable name for what went wrong, for programs to check and people to search for. |
| `const CodeBlankName Code = "events.blank-name" ...` | Error codes of this package. |
| `func Validate(draft Draft) []Code` | Validate lists every problem of a draft; none means it can be saved. |
| `type Detail struct{ ... }` | Detail is a fair with the stock taken to it, the sales made there and what it cost to attend. |
| `type Draft struct{ ... }` | Draft is what the event editor saves; status and times are worked out on saving. |
| `type Error struct{ ... }` | Error is a failure of the events: its code and what it was about. |
| `type Event struct{ ... }` | Event is a fair or a market. |
| `type Expense struct{ ... }` | Expense is money spent to attend a fair: the stand, travel, lodging. |
| `type Refusal struct{ ... }` | Refusal is why an action on a fair was turned down. |
| `type Screens struct{ ... }` | Screens are the fairs' pages: the list, one fair's detail, and the sheets over them. |
| `func NewScreens(store *Store, products *catalogue.Store, newID func() string, ...) *Screens` | NewScreens draws the fairs kept in store, taking stock from products. |
| `type Status string` | Status tells whether a fair still takes stock and sales, or is finished and read-only. |
| `const Open Status = "OPEN" ...` | The statuses. |
| `type StockLine struct{ ... }` | StockLine is a physical variant taken to a fair: the units moved from the catalogue and the units sold there. |
| `type Store struct{ ... }` | Store keeps the fairs in the database; moving stock changes the catalogue in the same transaction. |
| `func NewStore(database *storage.Database, sold *sales.Store, now func() time.Time, ...) *Store` | NewStore keeps fairs in database, beside the sales they make; tests pass a fixed clock and ids. |
| `type Summary struct{ ... }` | Summary is the totals of a fair. |
| `func Summarise(detail Detail) Summary` | Summarise adds up the sales and expenses of a fair. |
| `type Timing int` | Timing is where a fair stands from today: happening now, still to come, or past (or closed). |
| `const Happening Timing = iota ...` | The timings, in the order the list shows them. |
| `func TimingOf(event Event, today calendar.Date) Timing` | TimingOf tells where a fair stands on today. |
